description: A steel box with a hinged lid and a handle worn smooth, packed the way people pack things they hope never to open: hose in three diameters, jubilee clips, brake line, emitter tape, fuses of the wrong rating, and a tube of something that seals anything. Heavy in the way that annoys you every mile.
name: box of truck spares

tags.description: A steel box with a hinged lid and a handle worn smooth, packed the way people pack things they hope never to open: hose in three diameters, jubilee clips, a coil of brake line, spare emitter tape, two fuses that are the wrong rating and one that's not, and a tube of something that says it seals anything. It's heavy in the way that reassures you at the yard and annoys you every single mile after.
